items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: "I think that was written by .. was it written by James Johnson?"

ctx.x: Well, let me go back just to see if we can say something rather, about how is it that one learns to improvise?

I don't know. I think the first sound that I really remember learning and maybe improvising something on, of course, was something I didn't record until many years later, but it was a tune called "Old Fashioned Love" that -- and it seems to me that might have been about 1921 or thereabouts, "Old Fashioned Love", da doo dee da ... I think that was written by .. was it written by James Johnson?
I was gonna try him or Mel Stizel.
